title: super call in a trait to a method with a @specialized method type parameter crashes specialize with "key not found: method super$m"
oracle: the program with every @specialized removed compiles and prints 2
generator: wave4/harness/erasure (Gen.scala, Driver.scala): override with a super call, on a method that has its own @specialized type parameter (-Dw4e.superpoly=true)
signature: nospec|crash/ok|CRASH java.util.NoSuchElementException: key not found: method super$N
detail: trait T1 overrides m[@specialized(Int) B] of trait T0 and calls super.m[B](p). The compiler throws NoSuchElementException from SpecializeTypes.SpecializationTransformer.addBody (SpecializeTypes.scala:2144) while duplicating the body of the specialized variant of T1.m: the body refers to the super accessor symbol super$m, which is not in the map that addBody consults. Without @specialized the program compiles and prints 2. The shape needs a trait override that calls super on a method specialized in its own type parameter, which is uncommon in application code but ordinary in specialized numeric libraries.
fix_sketch: Give the duplicated body the super accessor of the specialized variant, or keep the super call in the generic body and have the variant forward to it. No compatibility cost: the program does not compile today.
prior: none found (Z11 is a rejection of super[TB].m in a duplicated body; SP4 is duplicate super accessors at load time)
